# Daily AI Newsletter Digest - 6/4/2026

## 🔥 Top Stories
- Anthropic has introduced a new tier above Opus, called Mythos, which is reportedly powerful enough to brief governments on cybersecurity risks.
- Perplexity AI can now assist with taxes, drafting federal returns on official IRS forms and reviewing professionally prepared filings.
- Apple is rebuilding Siri as a standalone AI agent app with personal data access and systemwide voice control.

## 🤖 AI Models & Research
- Researchers propose two novel loss functions, Max-Flipped KL Divergence (KLmax) and KL-Wasserstein Loss, to improve data visualization in t-SNE.
- Anthropic's study found that people want AI to help them with professional excellence, personal transformation, and life management, rather than just saving time.
- Claude Code has introduced a new feature that allows users to have virtual pets in their terminals.

## 🛠️ Tools & Products
- Ollama's cloud is now powering OpenClaw, a personal AI assistant that can manage tasks such as clearing inboxes, sending emails, and managing calendars via messaging apps.
- ChatGPT has been rolled out on Apple CarPlay, allowing for voice mode interaction without text on the screen.
- Gap has embedded a direct checkout AI chatbot, turning Gemini into a part stylist and salesperson.
- Mudra Link, a neural wristband, reads EMG signals from the wrist and translates micro finger movements into device commands over Bluetooth.
- PikaStream 1.0, an open-source video chat skill, gives any agent a real-time face, voice, and the ability to run tasks mid-conversation.

## 📰 Industry News
- A company is shipping a robot every 90 minutes, with the CEO predicting a humanoid robot in every home within 10 years.
- Meta is planning to back 10 natural gas plants to power its new Hyperion AI data center, which could add 50% more CO2 to the company's footprint.
- Bluesky has launched Attie, an AI assistant that lets users build custom feeds.
- Salesforce has announced 30 new AI features for Slack.

## 📚 Resources & Learning
- The AI Automation Society has 272 new posts, 5535 comments, and 9715 new members, with resources available such as YouTube videos, online courses, and discussion forums.
- Nate Herk has posted several new videos on YouTube, including "I Built 500 AI Workflows, These 5 Actually Sell in 2026" and "Codex Just 10x’d Claude Code Projects".
- Ollama provides several AI models for users to try, including kimi-k2.5:cloud, glm-5:cloud, minimax-m2.7:cloud, and gemma4:31b-cloud.
- JournalClub.io offers a detailed explanation of a paper on novel loss functions for improved data visualization in t-SNE, with a full PDF of the paper and a podcast episode available.

Total Newsletters: 5

## Ollama Newsletter

### Key Highlights
- Ollama's cloud is now powering OpenClaw, a personal AI assistant that can manage tasks such as clearing inboxes, sending emails, and managing calendars via messaging apps.
- Ollama's cloud plans are designed to support the usage patterns of third-party tools like OpenClaw, with no surprise fees or bans on favorite integrations.
- Users can set up OpenClaw using the command "ollama launch openclaw" and customize it with "openclaw onboard".
- Several AI models are available to try, including kimi-k2.5:cloud, glm-5:cloud, minimax-m2.7:cloud, and gemma4:31b-cloud.

### Detailed Points
- Ollama is supporting the use of third-party tools like OpenClaw, which is a personal AI assistant capable of handling various tasks through messaging apps such as WhatsApp, Telegram, iMessage, or any other chat app.
- The integration of Ollama's cloud with OpenClaw allows for efficient management of tasks such as inbox clearance, email sending, and calendar management.
- Ollama's cloud plans are tailored to accommodate the usage patterns of tools like OpenClaw, ensuring a seamless experience without unexpected costs or restrictions on integrations.
- To set up OpenClaw, users can simply open a terminal and type "ollama launch openclaw". This command will also configure OpenClaw to use Ollama's web search functionality by default.
- For customization, users can run "openclaw onboard" to connect different chat apps or other integrations.
- Ollama provides several AI models for users to try, including kimi-k2.5:cloud, glm-5:cloud, minimax-m2.7:cloud, and gemma4:31b-cloud, offering a range of options for different needs.
- Users can download Ollama from the provided link and are encouraged to provide feedback directly via email or by joining Ollama's Discord channel.
- The newsletter reiterates Ollama's commitment to supporting its users, with links to important resources such as cloud plans, the Discord channel, and the download page.

### Important Links
- **Ollama's cloud plans**: https://ollama.com/pricing - This link provides detailed information on the pricing and plans offered by Ollama for its cloud services, which are designed to support third-party tools.
- **Ollama's cloud**: https://ollama.com/pricing - Similar to the above, this link directs to the pricing page where users can find more about Ollama's cloud services and how they can be used to power projects and integrations.
- **Discord channel**: https://discord.com/invite/ollama - This link invites users to join Ollama's Discord channel for community engagement, feedback, and discussions.
- **Download Ollama**: https://ollama.com/download - Users can download Ollama from this link to start using its services and integrate it with tools like OpenClaw.

newsletters.subject: AI - does it really save time?
newsletters.summary:
## Mindstream

### Key Highlights
- Anthropic's leaked model, Mythos, is a new tier above Opus and is reportedly powerful enough to brief governments on cybersecurity risks.
- A study by Anthropic found that people want AI to help them with professional excellence, personal transformation, and life management, rather than just saving time.
- The study also found that 81% of respondents said AI has taken at least one meaningful step toward their vision, but many are working more hours and feeling more stressed.
- Apple is reportedly rebuilding Siri as a standalone AI agent app with personal data access and systemwide voice control.
- Gap has embedded a direct checkout AI chatbot, turning Gemini into a part stylist and salesperson.

### Detailed Points
- Anthropic's study interviewed 81,000 people using an AI interviewer to understand what AI going well looks like in real people's lives.
- The top hopes for AI were professional excellence (19%), personal transformation, life management, time freedom, and financial independence.
- The study found that people are using AI to do things faster, but are not banking the time saved and are instead filling it with more work.
- The top worry about AI was unreliability, followed by cognitive atrophy, which is the fear that relying on AI will weaken human cognitive abilities.
- Other notable updates include Bluesky launching Attie, an AI assistant that lets users build custom feeds, and Salesforce announcing 30 new AI features for Slack.
- Meta is planning to back 10 natural gas plants to power its new Hyperion AI data center, which could add 50% more CO2 to the company's footprint.
- Researchers used AI simulations to decode a Roman limestone board game that had stumped archaeologists for years.
- Mantis Biotech is building AI-powered digital twins of the human body using synthetic data, starting with NBA athlete performance.

newsletters.subject: Novel Loss Functions for Improved Data Visualization in t-SNE
newsletters.summary:
## JournalClub.io Newsletter

### Key Highlights
- Researchers propose two novel loss functions, Max-Flipped KL Divergence (KLmax) and KL-Wasserstein Loss, to improve data visualization in t-SNE.
- The new loss functions aim to address the limitations of traditional KL divergence used in t-SNE, which prioritizes local relationships over global structure.
- The study evaluates the performance of KLmax and KL-Wasserstein Loss against standard t-SNE on five datasets and finds that both replacements outperform the original in most cases.

### Detailed Points
- t-SNE is a widely used tool for visualizing high-dimensional data by projecting it down to two dimensions while preserving the similarity relationships between data points.
- The traditional KL divergence used in t-SNE has limitations, such as being hyper-focused on local relationships and being asymmetric, which can lead to misleading visualizations.
- The proposed KLmax loss function measures the divergence based on the relative structure of similarity values, rather than comparing raw values, to preserve the closest-neighbor relationships.
- The KL-Wasserstein Loss combines KL divergence and Wasserstein distance to capture both local and global structure in the data.
- The study finds that KLmax is effective when local ranking among neighbors is the main concern, while KL-Wasserstein is effective when preserving the global layout of clusters is more important.
- The authors provide the full gradient derivations, statistical significance tests, and implementation details for the Wasserstein gradient estimation and parameter sensitivity analysis in the paper.
- The study highlights that visualization methods are not neutral and that the loss function decides what kinds of errors matter, making it essential to choose the right objective for the task at hand.

### Important Links
- **Original Paper**: [Read the full PDF of the paper](https://journalclub.io/track/zpA9StKZppvwDJl7MNiKBxkiJk0TwsAEHY9ExdKCUUJffY8rsh) to learn more about the proposed loss functions and their evaluation.

Novel Loss Functions for Improved Data Visualization in t-SNE   

If you're working with high-dimensional data, you might find yourself wanting to visualize it. To project it down into two dimensions, so you can get a better understanding of what's going on. Think scatter plots of customer segments, maps of gene expressions, or clusters of documents. t-SNE, the t-distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding, is one of the most widely used tools for doing that kind of thing.

![](https://journalclub.io/px/QNae3zCk4gBRGewOv9pL7MaceTzOi6UR7uHJKTbqRZAKvgyQvS)

Novel Loss Functions for Improved Data Visualization in t-SNE

JournalClub.io, April 5th, 2026  
  

[![Thumbnail of today's episode.](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/cI2uMWk4TjWt2S53dif8)](https://journalclub.io/episodes/novel-loss-functions-for-improved-data-visualization-in-t-sne?token=C6D8OVkEYaTTG5jpuLEy32J85ohYcCLiu4OcPcYf0VqmiuT90B)

Today's article comes from the journal of Machine Learning and Knowledge Extraction. The authors
